title: Iceland Explained
author: Radek Werbowski
description: Iceland Explained is for the ones who want to experience Iceland before they arrive, and for the ones already here who suspect the photo is not the point. This is A STORY. NOT A GUIDE, and not an audio tour telling you where to stand. It is Iceland told through wind, lava, salt, weather, folklore, towns, roads, silence, and pressure. Not what to capture. What to notice. What the place does to you. Because the island is indifferent to your itinerary. ICELAND. TOLD.
